retrievalProfile.description: A centered circular illustration containing stylized portraits, flanked by widely spaced minimalist typography on a textured cream background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular vignette featuring two stylized, back-to-back portraits in a painterly, muted style, set against a large expanse of off-white textured space with thin, widely spaced text above and below the circle.
coreVisualRelationships: Central circular focal point containing all illustrative detail
Symmetrical vertical alignment of text and image
High ratio of negative space to subject matter
Harmonious earth-tone palette within the circle contrasting with the neutral background
Thin, airy typography balancing the dense central illustration
coreInvariants: Circular frame with thin gold or yellow border
Muted, desaturated color palette with a paper-like texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a circular illustration centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular medallion acts as the primary anchor, drawing the eye to the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the central circle, and finishes at the bottom text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space surrounds the central elements, creating a sense of calm and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted greens, browns, and oranges within the illustration.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin gold/yellow border around the circle and soft coral/terracotta for the text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation and medium-to-high value, creating a faded, vintage appearance.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and pastels

composition.position: Top and bottom of the central circle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain minimalist symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric simplicity and clean lines match the era's aesthetic.
Provides a classic, legible feel with a humanistic touch.
Modern alternative that maintains the required geometric balance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured cream paper background with a centered circular illustration of two stylized portraits in profile, using a muted 1970s earth-tone palette and a thin gold circular border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, all-caps, light-weight geometric sans-serif text in a muted terracotta color, one above and one below the circle, with extremely wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and widely tracked?
Is the illustration contained within a perfect circle?
Is the background a textured off-white?
Are the colors muted and vintage-inspired?

mustRedesign: Do not use heavy black outlines

mustAchieve: Soft, diffused lighting in the illustration

postGenerationChecks: Check that the circle is perfectly centered.
Verify that the text tracking is consistent between top and bottom lines.
Ensure the paper texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the color palette remains within the muted earth-tone range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Circle + Wide-Tracked Light Sans-Serif + Muted Earth Tones + Textured Negative Space
